title: vallaris indica
intro: Vallaris indica, commonly known as 'Vetiver', is a perennial herb native to India, Sri Lanka, and parts of Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and treating various skin conditions such as acne and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Vetiver include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of Vetiver include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
